course.title: Engineering Construction Management
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A solid shaft is subjected to simultaneous twisting. and bending due to a (15) torque T and a maximum bending moment M. Express the maximum shearing stress τ and the maximum normal stress σ in terms of T, M and the radius r of the shaft. By means of these relations, determine the proper diameter of a solid shaft to carry simultaneously T = 9000 Ib-ft and M = 600 lb-ft τ ≤10ksi and $\sigma \le 1 6 k s i$
